Questions we hear often.

Which areas do you cover?

Our office is in Ngong. We list and manage homes in Karen, Runda, Kitisuru, Westlands, Parklands, Ruiru (Mugutha) and Ngong.

How do I book a viewing?

Message us on WhatsApp or call +254 103 009787 with the estate you like. We will confirm a time.

Can you manage my property if I live abroad?

Yes. We collect rent, handle tenants and maintenance, and send you regular statements.

How do BNB stays work?

Pick your dates, send us a message and we confirm availability, price and check-in details.

What does it cost?

Fees depend on the service and the property. Call or WhatsApp us for current rates.
